firstApplicationSegment.guestMessage: map; subsequent operation still stopped at LP timer

contracts: Strict-ROM selection explicitly supplies raw[2048,2048] and selects SAR byte configuration; all profile candidates validate before assignment. Raw/SRAM exit withdraws both.
The timer advances only after actual SAR REGI2C bytes/power, digital mode/pattern, XTAL and gates are configured. Captures alternate at real modeled timer edges without a per-trigger loop.

Before analog changes old inputs advance. An unsupported live route withdrawal restores the analog/ADC snapshots before any changed PLL/MSPI clock observations are published, preserving elapsed sampling before the attempted write.
RNG remains the existing independent deterministic per-read source. ADC capture does not increase RNG sample count; RNG reads do not generate ADC captures.

CPU retains HP digital ADC state; Core clears digital config/captures and retains the selected ideal raw inputs. LP/system withdraws analog readiness; Chip clears SAR byte history and explicitly selects the virtual input profile again.

Global pending reset blocks ADC MMIO advancement. Only watchdog controllers use actual event-at arbitration; ADC reset/report timing remains at the Bus service boundary, not asynchronous physical reset timing.

negativeHistory.outcome: Adjacent VDET if statements and a checked Option unwrap triggered denied lints. A line break and equivalent virtual-timer/if-let guard fixed them without allowances; the21 focused tests pass afterward.

limits: No ADC DONE/data/status/IRQ/DMA or ordinary external ADC mode support. Captures are zero-conversion-delay functional bookkeeping of explicit ideal raw inputs, not actual analog conversion.
Reported phase/count is lazy controller state at its last observation; last_at identifies the last captured edge. No physical ADC or cryptographic entropy claim.
First actual remaining gap is LP_TIMER snapshot/time. No original app entry, LCD framebuffer, buttons, TF mount or Wi-Fi acceptance.

Full default-LTO workspace tests, CPU controls, final integrated production WASM/browser and fresh final release acceptance remain pending. Latest private cold-ABI contract also needs the final rebuilt WASM. No C5 publication.
